script: const changes=[];for(const id of ['3:123','7:16661']){const n=pixso.getNodeById(id);const t=n.findOne(c=>c.type==='INSTANCE'&&c.name.startsWith('Phase timer'));const props=t.componentProperties;const key=Object.keys(props).find(k=>k.startsWith('Context'));if(!key)return{error:'Timer context property unavailable',id,props};t.setProperties({[key]:'Раунд'});const value=t.componentProperties[key]?.value;if(value!=='Раунд')return{error:'Context write mismatch',id,key,value};changes.push({id,timer:t.id,value});}return{verified:true,changes};
